title: Policies
desc: Education and refund policies for our photography classes.

blocks.html:
REGISTRATION

Workshops are scheduled in advance for the Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter. Please check our Online Learning and In-Person Workshop pages for updates on ongoing and upcoming classes.

Detailed workshop descriptions and material fees can be found for each workshop or class. We recommend that you read through these descriptions carefully before registering. Please contact us should you have any questions.

Please note that most workshops are for learning a photographic process, not building an artwork portfolio.

Penumbra Foundation accepts all major credit cards. Students must pay in full at the time of registration. Penumbra Foundation does not guarantee placement in a workshop until payment is received.

WAIT LIST

If your desired workshop is full, you can contact us and request to be added to the wait-list in the event a spot opens up. Please email your request to Griffin@penumbrafoundation.org and include your contact details (name, phone, and email address) and the title of the workshop you are interested in. Wait-list priority is given on a first-come, first-served basis.

CANCELATIONS AND WITHDRAWALS

In the event a student must withdraw from a workshop before and up to 14 days prior to the workshop start date, the student will receive a 90% refund. Similarly, students who wish to switch from one class to another prior to 14 days of the start date, will be able to transfer 90% of their already paid tuition.

In the event a student must withdraw from a workshop within 14 days and outside of 72 hours prior to the start of the workshop, the student will receive a 50% refund. The same 50% refund is applied for those wishing to switch classes.

A withdrawal made within 72 hours (3 days) of a class will NOT be entitled to any refund. For example, a class taking place on a Saturday requires withdrawal be made prior to the Wednesday beforehand (11:59pm EST Tuesday).

Please provide us with as much advance notice as possible for consideration. Beyond this, Penumbra Foundation cannot be held responsible for any cancelations outside of Penumbra Foundation’s control.

Unless otherwise stated, classes need a minimum of three students to run. In the off chance that a class is canceled due to low enrollment, you will be refunded 100% of your tuition, minus CC processing fees (2.9% + $.30). The decision to cancel a class based on low registration will be made one week before the first workshop date. In the event of such a cancelation due to low enrollment, 100% of tuition costs can also be transferred to other classes or workshops.

Penumbra Foundation is not responsible for any non-refundable travel costs (such as airfare, train tickets or accommodation costs). If you are traveling long distances or from out of state, we advise you to consider purchasing travel insurance as workshops may be canceled or postponed due to low registration or other unforeseen circumstances.

A rain date is scheduled for all outdoor workshops in case of inclement weather. In the event of rain date, the cancellation/withdrawal policy still applies to the originally scheduled workshop date. Once the originally planned workshop date has passed, a student is not entitled to a refund. Please check the rain date for all outdoor workshops before registering!

WORKSHOP MATERIALS

Any work created by workshop participants that is not taken home at the time of the workshop will be available for pickup on an appointment basis after the time of the workshop.

If you need to retrieve prints from the Penumbra Foundation facilities, please call 917-288-0343 to make an appointment to pick up your images.

Any images left at Penumbra Foundation for over 30 days can and will be discarded at Penumbra’s discretion.

WORKSHOP ABSENCES

No-Show: If a student misses the first day of a multi-day workshop, they forfeit their spot for the remainder of the class.

Due to the intensive nature of our workshops, we cannot offer makeup sessions outside of workshop time or in future workshops. Instructors are not required to bring students up to date during scheduled workshop time for missed days or lateness.

Refunds will not be given for absences or no shows. *This includes any illness or absence related to Covid 19.

If you have any questions, please give us a call or send an email to Griffin@penumbrafoundation.org

ONLINE CLASS RECORDING POLICY

Instructors have the option to record online classes, providing an accessible resource for absent students. This is entirely at the instructor's discretion. Due to copyright ownership of course materials, not all instructors may choose to record lectures or discussions. In such cases, many will instead provide alternative materials like PDFs, documents, or links to help students catch up. The sharing of these materials is also at the instructor's discretion, given their copyright ownership.

When a real-time class is being recorded, instructors are required to notify all participants. If you anticipate missing an online class, it's best to discuss this with your instructor in advance. Neither Penumbra nor the instructor can be held responsible for missed coursework due to absences, regardless of the circumstances. Platforms like Zoom and Google Classroom prohibit users/participants from using their services to violate or infringe any intellectual property or proprietary rights of others, including copyrights. If you have concerns regarding these policies, please contact us before registering for an online class.

Our online class policy permits instructors to share class recordings at their discretion. However, it is not standard practice to provide recordings for students who have missed a majority of the sessions. This policy is in place to ensure student attendance and prevent misuse of class recordings.

Scholarships and Financial Aid

Penumbra is unable to offer any scholarships or financial aid.

Image Use Policy

By participating in a workshop at Penumbra, you acknowledge that you may be photographed or filmed and grant Penumbra the right to use your likeness or images of your work for promotional, advertising, or educational purposes.

NON-HARASSMENT & SEXUAL HARASSMENT POLICIES

Penumbra Foundation is an educational institution, and violation of this policy in our programs will not be tolerated on the part of the Instructor, Teaching Assistant, Intern, participant, or any third party. Harassment of any kind in Penumbra Foundation programs may result in immediate removal from programs without refund of payments rendered. Conduct that will result in removal from Penumbra Foundation programs includes, but is not limited to, harassment based on age, race, color, creed, military status, national origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, as well as sexual harassment, which includes, but is not limited to, unwelcome sexual advances, requests for sexual favors, and/or verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature including but not limited to sexually-related drawings, pictures, jokes, teasing, e-mails, text messages, uninvited touching, or other sexually-related comments. The conduct prohibited by this policy includes conduct in any form including but not limited to e-mail, voicemail, chat rooms, Internet use or history, text messages, pictures, images, writings, words, or gestures.

If any participant in a Penumbra Foundation program believes there has been a violation of these policies, they should notify the Instructor or Teaching Assistant of their workshop immediately. If no action is taken, or the action taken is deemed insufficient by the participant, the participant should remove themselves from the situation, and contact the Workshop Coordinator at (917) 288-0343, molly@penumbrafoundation.org or in person at 36 East 30th Street, New York, NY 10016, and the complaint will be investigated and you will be contacted regarding your complaint.

LIABILITY WAIVER

I understand that by participating in a workshop:

¥ I agree to take on full responsibility for any damage, loss or theft incurred to personal property that I bring into Penumbra Foundation.

¥ I understand that all storage of personal property, either brought in from the outside or created at Penumbra Foundation is my exclusive responsibility.

¥ I agree to take on full responsibility for any injuries, risks, damages, known or unknown for bodily and/or personal property that I may sustain as a result of participating in a workshop or use of equipment owned by Penumbra Foundation and its facilities.

¥ I agree I am voluntarily participating in these workshops and assume all risks. I hereby release Penumbra Foundation, its employees, staff, instructors, volunteers, owners, and representatives, as well as, all facilities where these activities occur for any claim that I, my heirs, or legal representatives may have for any damage, damages, injuries, known or unknown, incurred bodily and/or/to personal property.
